preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) >= 1 and lines[0].strip().isdigit() if (lines := stdin.splitlines()) else False
preconditions.description: The first line contains a valid integer representing the number of groups.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines)) if i % (n + 1) == 1]) if (lines := stdin.splitlines()) and len(lines) > 1 else True
preconditions.description: The number of friends in each group is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The graph for each group is connected, and every node has at least one neighbor and no self-loops.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per group, where num_groups is the integer from the first line of input.

postconditions.expression: all(' ' in line and len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two space-separated values: the friend label and the average distance.

postconditions.expression: all(int(parts[0]) == min_label and abs(float(parts[1]) - round(avg_dist, 6)) < 1e-6 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() for parts in [line.split()] for min_label, avg_dist in [compute_best_friend_and_avg_dist(parse_group(line_idx, lines))]) if (lines := stdin.splitlines()) else True
postconditions.description: For each group, the output label is the smallest friend ID among those with the minimum average distance to all other friends, and the second value is that minimum average distance formatted to six decimal places.
